race.comment: OUR LADY PEACE (2) sets the standard after going under by a neck when third at this track first-up, where she started favourite and was only claimed late. She has placed five times from six runs at around 1000m, so the trip is no issue, and the second-up profile with Jason Collett aboard gives her a very solid platform. No excuses from the draw. BRUTAL ADVANCE (1) is far more exposed, but the Kembla Grange third was honest given he jumped awkwardly, raced keenly and covered ground. The winless 1000m record tempers the case, though his place consistency keeps him in the mix. TOKYO SWEETS (7) is a Maurice filly on debut for the Baker stable. Fitted with three recent trials and comes up with the prized rails draw. Leading contender. CRESTWOOD (6) is deep into the prep and drops in trip. Keep safe.
